questions: How are ADR status lines shaped across docs/ADR_*.md, and do they carry a machine-readable binding to an implementing phase?
Can an ADR be bound to its implementing phase through META_LEDGER entry headings?
What lint/detector conventions in qor/scripts/ must a new ADR status detector match, and where does it wire?
What does qor/scripts/ already provide for git/gh introspection that an extended /qor-status tier can reuse?
Does gh availability need a fail-safe path for CI and forks with no token?
How does an actor classification separating bot from developer and agent work get implemented without duplicating an existing predicate?
Does the <5KB default budget and skill size headroom constrain adding an opt-in --full tier?

findings.summary: The three ADRs share no common machine-readable binding field; ADR_QOR_ROADMAP.md:3 names neither a phase nor an issue, so a status-line detector would report clean on the stalest ADR.

Phase-to-ledger binding verified by execution: walk() returns a complete 722-of-722 enumeration; Phase 239->#656, 240->#644, 241->#649. Ids 510/532 are genuine ledger numbering gaps, not parser drops.
All three ADRs are Tier 2 rows, but the Tier 2 contract has no freshness-marker column, so the tier tracking them cannot express staleness.
Lint CLI/finding conventions and generic scripts dispatch already exist; a new qor/scripts/<name>.py needs no registration and can register as a status_json ladder Check.

Machine-author classification exists twice with divergent predicates behind a docstring claiming parity it does not have. Latent, not live: the narrow form's only caller passes the login form it matches.

github_surface supplies the reusable gh pattern: injected fetcher for testability, exit 2 on (RuntimeError, OSError, ValueError) covering both a failing and an absent gh. No shutil.which probe exists in the corpus.
Assumption refuted by measurement: qor-status is 7,369 B against a 25 KB WARN threshold (18,231 B headroom). The progressive-disclosure pressure that constrained Phase 257 does not apply.
Actor baseline on origin/main: 722 commits = 621 developer, 88 agent, 13 bot. Dependabot holds 9 commits, 15 PRs all-time (0 open), 0 outstanding branches.
